scope: For a finitely generated graded polynomial module over C, generated in degree zero, with dim M_d=2 and d>=2, a general linear form ell makes ell^(d-1):M_1 -> M_d surjective. A good square gives an explicit algebraic rank-one target-automorphism family through the original coefficient geometry after a degree-two parameter change. The polynomial endpoint quotient has global length at most 60 and support at at most four parameters. On the automorphism locus its local length is at most 30 and its local torsion exponent is at most two; the completed original fiber is reconstructed from the first auxiliary-parameter jet. The fixed quotient is not evaluated, no relative higher-direct-image identification is made, and source membership, pure-six conditions, module lifting, and algebraicity of a formal quantization or module remain unresolved.
